items.title: Stuart Bergen Interview, 1970-07-18
items.q: On order of Charleston Heston you might say on that order.

ctx.x: While we're talking about different things we didn't get into Lester Nelson very much. He's a guy that I hear people talk about and don't know much about him.

Now we're going back to about 1933 or 34. At the Rialto Club is where I met Lester Nelson. Real good looking guy Dick. On order of Charleston Heston you might say on that order. Maybe not as big. Real fine looking man. He had a wonderful ear for harmony. He didn't read. He was a guy. And I don't remember his, I don't know how he's driving like Murray used to drive on tenor. We call him riding the beat. Yeah. But I know one thing everybody said that he was one of the best team up men going on tenor. And we heard…
Who did he sound like as we know through records? Anybody in particular?
